V26-3514.title: Define the public snapshot and reusable projection

criteria.text: Produce one explicit data-only public view contract without weakening local rendering.
Meet the approved plan's R3, R5, R6, R13, R14; F1/F2; AE1/AE5.
Python and service read the same valid/invalid fixture set; existing local render assertions remain unchanged. This seam proves projection, not Cloudflare/browser behavior.

V26-3515.title: Build scoped ingestion and persistent snapshot commits

criteria.text: Accept authenticated repository updates without snapshot regression or partial publication.
Meet the approved plan's R1, R5, R8, R11–R13; F1/F3; AE4/AE5.
Tests execute against real local Worker/DO/R2 bindings, not only storage mocks; targeted injected failures cover both sides of the commit boundary. These tests do not prove production deployment.

V26-3516.title: Serve the trusted hosted line map

criteria.text: Show the reused delivery UI with truthful freshness and safe public reads.
Meet the approved plan's R1–R3, R6, R8–R10, R14; F2/F4; AE2/AE3/AE6.
Real browser checks cover signed-out viewing, CSP, referrer, mobile layout and keyboard detail navigation; jsdom covers store/poll behavior but is not browser-security proof.

V26-3517.title: Implement the portable watcher and uploader

criteria.text: Automatically publish coherent changes and recover ambiguous acknowledgements.
Meet the approved plan's R4–R9, R11–R13; F1–F3; AE2–AE5.
A local fixture receiver checks protocol, bounded retries and process behavior; it is explicitly not Cloudflare proof.

V26-3519.title: Package, document and qualify the integration

criteria.text: Ship all reusable files in selected profiles and prove configuration-only adoption.
Meet the approved plan's R4, R6, R7, R12, R13; F1; AE1/AE5.
Installed-archive proof is recorded separately from source tests and service CI; no fixture result is described as live proof.

V26-3520.title: Deploy and prove a real adopter delivery

criteria.text: Make the custom-domain viewer operational and prove its intended off-machine behavior.
Meet the approved plan's R1–R14; F1–F4; AE1–AE6.

Preserve actual custom-domain HTTP/browser evidence, disconnect/reconnect results, exact deployed bytes and installed-archive identity; stop short of deployment completion if any prerequisite or live proof remains unavailable.

V26-3527.title: Complete bounded hosted publishing and archive recovery
V26-3527.why: Kwamina explicitly authorized a tracked remediation follow-up with a fresh two-round review limit after the original lifecycle review reached its terminal four-round bound; preserve all prior dissent and evidence.

criteria.text: Meet the retained U5 lifecycle and privacy obligations, deliver terminal intent under live CONTROL contention within the close budget, prove truthful live pending status, and preserve stable same-ID archive recovery under bounded transitional polling.

CONTROL contention cannot prevent bounded terminal notification to an existing owner; close stays within 30 seconds, the owner exits by its ten-minute terminal deadline if pending, and same-ID archive recovery remains possible.
Live hosted_info and hosted_line report final-publication-pending with the existing URL and preceding receipt; deleting that fallback fails its regression.
Active archive polling uses bounded production unavailability handling, then direct post-exit assertions verify stable identity, receipt and status while persistent corruption still fails.
The full retained lifecycle and c1 privacy behavior remains covered by installed-generation command/process tests, strict receiver fixtures and coherent capture of the actual delivery record.
